Name: Gothic Girlypop Black Cat Retexture
Author: mygenderisgremlin
Description:
Retexture/recolour of the black cat in Stardew Valley! 🐈‍⬛🌸

[b]Changes:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Changed coat to darker black (almost sooty) so it's got less of a purple undertone than the vanilla version
[*]Added cute white "socks" (aka paws) 
[*]Added white tip to the tail 
[*]Also, added light grey "eyebrows" (literally a single pixel above each eye) - I feel like this gives a sense of facial expressions haha
[*]Catto now has spooky purple eyes and a lil pink flower behind one ear :D 
[/list]
[b]Requirements:
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ latest version (duh) 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ latest version (obviously)

I highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url]﻿ to manage your mods, but it is not required.

[b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install latest version of SMAPI. 
[*]Install latest version of Content Patcher. 
[*]Install this mod either manually or with a mod manager.
[*]You're done! If the black cat is your starting pet, you'll get them at the usual time, or you can adopt them from Marnie once pet adoptions become available.
[/list]
[b]Compatibility:
[/b]This mod should be compatible with all the usual mods we have in our load orders. I have over 200 in my latest playthrough, and there are no conflicts or issues at least on my side.

Tested via my own playthrough on Stardew Valley 1.6 with the latest SMAPI and Content Patcher versions.

[b]To Do (still):[/b]

[*]Add adoption portrait(s) in the same style (I totally forgot to do this, I'll try sort it out soon) 
[/list]

[*]Adding to collections[b] - go for it :) [/b]
[*]Creating your own versions and uploading on Nexus [b]- go crazy! But please credit me for the original <3[/b]
[/list][b]Credits:
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url] for SMAPI and Content Patcher

[b]Tools Used: 
[/b]Thank f*** for [url=https://www.pixquare.art/]Pixsquare[/url] because I am 1) very new to this, and 2) terrible at art, so trying to make this mod on my iPad using Pro Create was driving me bananas.
